title: Printable Weekly Planner, Undated A4 and US Letter PDF
description:
Plan your week with an undated printable layout. This digital set includes two PDF files: one A4 version and one US Letter version.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
Two non-editable PDFs of the same one-page weekly layout, sized for A4 and US Letter paper. No physical item is shipped.

HOW TO USE
Open your chosen file in a PDF viewer and print it on matching paper. The dates are blank so you can use the layout for any week. The files are not an editable template and no online editing link is included.

USAGE
For personal use only. A commercial-use license is not included.
